name: Algebraic Minimax Reduction
description: Instead of describing a 2-stage flow shop with two workers and a FIFO queue, the problem is formulated as its exact algebraic equivalent: finding a permutation to minimize the maximum path weight in a 2xN grid. This strips away all scheduling terminology (machines, queues, jobs, makespan) that models rely on to recognize Johnson's rule, replacing it with an adversarial path-finding narrative.
